The petitioner's property, covered by Ext.P1 sale deed, was allegedly converted as a road without following any procedure under law.
The petitioner is, therefore, praying for restoring property covered by Ext.P1 to its original position.
The dispute started when the petitioner made an application for a building permit in the year 1995.
Ultimately, the permit was granted on 22.2.2018 through Ext.P7.
However, the Corporation issued Ext.P9 stop memo on 20.8.2018.
The present stand of the respondents is that the subject property is liable to be acquired.

2. Since the permit granted to the petitioner was stalled and the property was stated to be acquired,
this Court had passed orders on 16.2.2023, 27.2.2023, 3.4.2023 and 30.5.2024 calling for ..3..
the details of the proposed acquisition.

The order dated 30.5.2024 directed the Chief Secretary to file an affidavit as to the steps taken after the previous affidavit filed by them on 22.3.2023 and also,
the probable time required for completing the acquisition proceedings.

In obedience to the same, an affidavit has been filed on 11.7.2024 stating as follows:
"5.
It is submitted that following are the action taken on the proposal for acquisition of land after 22.03.2023.

Date Action taken File was forwarded to Revenue Department for remarks on acquisition of Land by invoking LARR 10/16/2023 Act 2013, Revenue Department returned the file instructing to submit the Requisition form by the requisition Authority, on 16/10/2023.
Principal Director, LSGD & Cochin Corporation were directed to furnish the requisition form and 10/26/2023 to inform the availability of Fund for acquisition of Land.
Oct 2023 - Feb Contacted Cochin Corporation several times over 2024 phone to furnish the documents called for.
As the report was not furnished from Cochin 02/29/2024 Corporation, Corporation was reminded.
As the report was not furnished, reminded again.

Cochin Corporation furnished the documents 07/08/2024 called for.
..4..
Administrative sanction for acquiring land has 07/10/2024 been issued vide G.O (Ms) No. 87/ 2024/ LSGD dated 10/7/24 The Revenue Department has been directed to take further action to the Land by invoking LARR Act 2013.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that the acquisition of land under Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and -- Resettlement Act, 2013 is a statutory process involving multiple steps.

entities.text: Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and -- Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The pre-acquisition steps involve identification of land requirement, allocating funds and issuance of Administrative sanction which have been completed in this case.

The remaining steps involve the following:
 Social Impact Assessment-Study and evaluation  Preliminary Notification under S.11(1)  Declaration under S.19(1)  Award under S.25  Rehabilitation and resettlement package under S.31  Taking possession of the land under S.38 7.

It is submitted that strict direction has been given to the Revenue Department and District Collector to complete the procedure at any cost within one year and to the Corporation and Local Self Government Department to ensure necessary support for acquisition of land.

Regular monitoring will be ensured in this regard."
3.
The above statements made by the Chief Secretary are recorded.

Accordingly, the Writ Petition is ordered directing the ..5..
entire acquisition proceedings to be completed within one year from 11.7.2024.

In case the acquisition proceedings are not completed by that day, it will be open to the petitioner to commence construction based on the permit granted to him on 22.2.2018 after getting the necessary renewal.
The Writ Petition is disposed of as above.

Sd/-
MOHAMMED NIAS C. P. , JUDGE MMG ..6..
